edits.old: And the harness makes no call to any NLEADS interface
edits.new:
And the harness makes no call to any NLEADS interface

  Scenario: AC12 NLEADS has no interface; the harness reaches no NLEADS address and the officer records the result (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the harness has no interface to NLEADS
    When the harness runs the credit approval pack for treatment "TRT-SYN-0610"
    Then the harness sends no request to any NLEADS address
    And the result is recorded only by the officer

  Scenario: AC13 A redelivered consumed event is applied once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the event "TreatmentApproved" for treatment "TRT-SYN-0610" has been consumed once
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the treatment, the route state and the outbox are unchanged by the second delivery
    And no second CaseStateChanged or TreatmentApproved event exists
BR4 is asserted by AC5 and AC12.
